name: tungsten
lore_descriptor: so heavy it draws the arm down
first_pickup_chronicle: Tungsten. So dense the weapon feels alive — fighting you, until you stop fighting it. Magic slides off it like rain. Heavy weapons made from this drop foes the way landslides drop trees.
design_notes: Fills pf 48 gap. Heavy-family bonus (damage_mult 1.4, weight 1.6×). Magic-resistant (max_enchant 1) — warrior favorite, anti-mage.
